wrong_turns: Moving the shelf before Pac uses the distant brake may leave Isp facing a closed door, but whether this traps anyone is unknown.

The dialogue says the door opens when the shelf stops, yet it does not identify which pad or wall performs the stop.

No player action establishes route, recovery, or shared-keyboard friction; one-operator coordination is separate.
